reason: Semantic formatting tags (, , , ) are NOT converted to inline-styled elements in the newsletter body HTML. The convertTipTapToInlineHTML() function in src/lib/promotion-email-html.ts only converts block-level elements (h2, h3, p, ul, li, a) to inline-styled versions but passes through inline formatting elements unchanged. Specifically: bold should be bold, italic should be italic, underlined should be underlined, and should be . Text color and highlight background-color DO work correctly as inline styles (from TipTap extensions), but the core semantic tag conversions are missing.
